items.article_text:
Post oficial de @pearljam no Instagram (IMAGE), 2026-10-14T21:37:38+0000.

Legenda original:
A day at the beach should be for everyone. 🌊

Washington’s Westport Light State Park protects fragile coastal ecosystems and gives people room to surf, walk the trails, watch wildlife and enjoy the ocean.

A proposed privately operated golf course would reshape this coastal landscape, raising serious concerns about wetlands, public access, water quality and erosion. 

Help keep Westport wild: submit an online comment to Washington State Parks by tomorrow, Thursday, October 15, at 5 pm PT. Tell them why public parks and beach access matter to you.

Want to show up in person? Attend the Special Commission meeting on Monday, October 19, from 5:30–9 pm at Aberdeen High School Auditorium.

Head to the link in bio for the comment form and Surfrider’s guide to participating.

#KeepWestportWild
#PublicBeachesNotPrivateGreens
#PublicLandsNeedPublicVoices
